subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Not every problem can be solved at once.”?
options: Sometimes improving the place where work happens helps the person doing the work.
Sometimes it begins with a button.
Sometimes they wait beside the door.
Sometimes improvement is still worth doing.
